scripts.help: echo "build:rust build:release build:cli build:web test test:rust test:web fmt format lint dev dev:admin dev:daemon dev:web fleet web:install e2e e2e:ui e2e:stress docs:check docs:build"
scripts.test: pnpm run test:rust && pnpm run test:web
scripts.test:web: pnpm --filter @agent-fleet/web exec tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @agent-fleet/web lint
scripts.dev: VITE_DEFAULT_API_TOKEN=${FLEET_ADMIN_TOKEN:-dev-token} pnpm run build:web && pnpm run dev:admin
scripts.e2e: cargo build -p fleet-admin -p fleet-daemon -p fleet-cli && cargo test -p fleet-e2e-tests --test smoke --test setup --test lifecycle --test git_write -- --ignored
scripts.e2e:ui: cargo build -p fleet-admin -p fleet-daemon -p fleet-cli && cargo test -p fleet-e2e-tests --test ui -- --ignored
scripts.e2e:stress: cargo build -p fleet-admin -p fleet-daemon -p fleet-cli && cargo test -p fleet-e2e-tests --test multi_machine -- --ignored --test-threads=1
